title: Docs for the clip folder: tools, concepts, glossary, design note, vocabulary
description:
## Intent

Document the browsable clip folder.

## Scope

- `docs/tools.md`: `apricity export --clips` in the "Exporting to a DAW" section (next to `--sidecars` and `--daw-set`), when to use which, and how to add the output folder to the DAW's browser.
- `docs/concepts.md` (Automatic markup): one paragraph on browsing markup in the DAW; link to the naming rule written by apricitus-a0ae4c instead of repeating it.
- `docs/glossary.md`: "Clip folder".
- `design/daw-presets.md`: a layout section; `design/vocabulary.md`: the clip folder row.
- No vendor or DAW product names.

## Verification

A case-insensitive grep of docs/, design/ and README.md for the vendor's name prints nothing; a reviewer runs the documented example on a sample and the layout matches the docs.

## Release

`docs(<this task id>): clip folder export`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
